scene: You emerge onto the rooftop transit hub above the whirring zoo domes.
picture: Side-scrolling view of a wide rooftop transit platform. On the far left, a paint-splattered tram waits on metal rails. Left of centre stands the Pacific Islander girl clutching her sketchbook. In the centre, a brass revolving door lift glimmers. On the right, a striped overhead gondola cabin sways on heavy cables.
shown: A bright, paint-splattered tram sits parked on tracks on the far left.
A polished brass revolving door lift stands glowing in the centre.
A swinging striped gondola cabin hangs waiting from cables on the right.
